INSERT INTO mrp_material_policy_notice (batch_id, run_id, factory_code, material_code, material_name, missing_type, effective_explosion_policy, sources_json) VALUES
(#{r.batchId}, #{r.runId}, #{r.factoryCode}, #{r.materialCode}, #{r.materialName}, #{r.missingType}, #{r.effectiveExplosionPolicy}, #{r.sourcesJson})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mrp_material_policy_notice ORDER BY material_code, factory_code LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mrp_material_policy_notice WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND missing_type IN ('EXPLOSION', 'BOTH') AND default_explosion_confirmed_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mrp_material_policy_notice WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND default_explosion_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE mrp_material_policy_notice SET default_explosion_confirmed_by=#{operatorId}, default_explosion_confirmed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND missing_type IN ('EXPLOSION', 'BOTH') AND default_explosion_confirmed_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_factory_scope ufs WHERE ufs.user_id=#{userId} AND ufs.factory_code=#{factory}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON r.id=ur.role_id JOIN role_data_scope ds ON ds.role_id=r.id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND (ds.scope_type='ALL' OR (ds.scope_type='FACTORY' AND ds.scope_value=#{factory}))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
